name: Mobile app
addressFormat: Router path or deep link, e.g. /group/[id]/settings or headcount://join/:code

decisionChecklist.question: Which screens require a session, and where does a signed-out (or unverified) user land when they reach one?
What happens with no network: cached data, queued writes, or an error?
How are errors shown (Alert, inline text, toast), and is the wording consistent?
What do the back gesture and hardware back do on each modal/sheet, and do unsaved edits survive?
Which surfaces open from a deep link or push notification, and what does a stale/invalid link show?
Which OS permissions are requested (notifications, camera…), when, and what happens on deny?
How is success confirmed for actions that don't navigate (haptics, animation, toast)?
Dynamic Type, VoiceOver labels, reduce-motion and minimum tap-target behaviour.
Which actions are destructive (leave, delete, remove), and how are they confirmed?
